title: Trade Agreement With US Close to Completion, Thai Prime Minister Says
gist: Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul said the US-Thailand Agreement on Reciprocal Trade is on its 'last paragraph' and could be signed during Trump's next Asia trip, at the ASEAN Summit in the Philippines (Nov 16-18) or APEC in Shenzhen (Nov 18-19).

insights.claim: Thai PM Anutin Charnvirakul said in October 2026 that US-Thailand trade negotiations on the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade are in the final stages, on 'the last paragraph'.
insights.speaker: Sebastian Strangio
insights.so_what: Deal completion would reduce tariff uncertainty for Thai exporters and baht assets.

insights.claim: Thailand expects to sign the Agreement on Reciprocal Trade with the US as soon as November 2026, during Trump's next visit to Asia.
insights.speaker: Sebastian Strangio
insights.so_what: Gives a near-term catalyst date for Thai trade-exposed equities.

insights.claim: The US-Thailand deal could be signed at the ASEAN Summit in the Philippines on November 16-18, which Trump has confirmed attending, or at APEC meetings in Shenzhen on November 18-19, where his attendance is unconfirmed.
insights.speaker: Sebastian Strangio
insights.so_what: A possible Trump trip to Shenzhen for APEC is itself a US-China signal worth watching.
insights.quote: Trump’s attendance at the latter summit has not yet been confirmed.
